description: Edits videos on our servers. reframe: one video to 9:16, 16:9 or 1:1, cropped around a focus point or padded with a blurred copy of itself. assemble: clips joined in order (each optionally trimmed), with an optional audio track over them (music or a voice-over, with its volume and the clips' own volume), optional burned-in captions from a speech-to-text result (text plus timed words), and loudness brought to -14 LUFS; 1080x1920 or the first clip's size. Inputs: links to generation results (our CDN) or links from upload_media. $0.002 per second of output: the most it can cost is held, the real length is charged; a failed edit costs nothing. Limits: 20 clips of up to 120 s, 180 s of output. Waits about a minute; if still running, check with get_edit — don't start it again.

aspect_ratio.description: reframe: the new aspect ratio (required for reframe).

audio_start.description: assemble: where in the track to start, seconds.

audio_url.description: assemble: an audio track (MP3/WAV/M4A) laid over the clips, cut or padded to their length.

audio_volume.description: assemble: the track's volume, 1 = as is (default).

captions.description: assemble: burned-in captions. The speech-to-text result: { text, words: [{ text, start, end }] } or { segments: [{ text, start, end }] }, times on the output's timeline. Optional style: { position: bottom|middle|top, highlight: true, max_words: 3, uppercase: false }.

clip_volume.description: assemble: the clips' own sound, 1 = as recorded (default), 0 = muted.

clips.description: assemble: the clips in order; start and end (seconds) trim each one.

end.description: reframe: end of the part to keep, seconds.

fit.description: assemble: how clips of another shape fill the frame; blur (default) keeps them whole.

focus_x.description: reframe, crop: what to keep in view, 0 (left) to 1 (right); default 0.5.

mode.description: reframe: crop (default) fills the frame; blur keeps the whole picture on a blurred background.

run_again.description: Make another one even if the same request was just made.

size.description: assemble: 1080x1920 (default) or the first clip's own size.

start.description: reframe: start of the part to keep, seconds.

name: edit_video
title: Edit video
